rationale: The agent submitted an exchange without clearly authenticating the user or verifying the order belongs to Sofia. There is no explicit confirmation from the user before the write action; the agent’s “Thank you for confirming” is not supported by any prior confirmation step in the conversation. The replacement camera changes specifications beyond zoom (24MP to 30MP), violating the user’s requirement that all other specs remain the same. The agent also did not demonstrate that the selected camera has the maximum zoom capacity while keeping other specs identical. Additionally, it stated a specific price difference charged to PayPal without presenting supporting tool outputs. These issues violate the policy requirements for authentication, confirmation prior to order-changing writes, acting only on the user’s orders with verification, and avoiding unsupported claims. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
